title: Data Privacy Analyst
description: We are looking for a Data Privacy Analyst to join our growing global team. This is an exciting opportunity for someone early in their career, ideally with a background in IT, or data management, and a keen interest in data protection. Candidates must have some understanding of data protection laws and interest in applying them in real world situations. The role will support our Global Data Privacy function in protecting personal data, helping us meet regulatory requirements of global Data protection Laws. **WHY JOIN US?** * Work with a global team in a fast-moving FinTech environment. * Get mentorship and training in a rapidly growing and important field. * Be part of real-world projects that have a direct impact on global data protection. **ROLE AND RESPONSIBILITIES** * Contribute and support to maintaining a Data Privacy Framework across the group (UK, Europe, and APAC. * Maintain procedures to respond to Subject Access Requests (SARs). * Maintain procedures to respond to requests for right to be forgotten or for retention and erasure of data. * Help maintain personal data inventory ROPA and Data discovery targeting of personal data held by the CMC Group * Help build dashboards or generate reports/metrics on data privacy KPIs (e.g. breach trends, response times). * Contribute to internal awareness campaigns, newsletters, and training materials to boost data privacy understanding across teams. * Maintain personal/professional development to meet the changing demands of the role, including all relevant regulatory and legislative training * When dealing with all customers, clients or colleagues ensure that we provide a clear, fair and consistent high-quality service that presents a professional and positive image of CMC Markets, take all reasonable steps to ensure appropriate confidentiality * Undertake such other duties, training and/or hours of work as may be reasonably required, and which are consistent with the general level of responsibility of this role. * Support due diligence and manage third party risk including reviewing contracts and DPA’s. title: Account Director
description: **The opportunity** This is a senior, hands-on client leadership role at the intersection of client engagement, commercial growth, technology transformation and people. Based in Kraków, the Account Director will be the visible local face of GFT for one of our most strategic global banking clients while operating as an integral part of the wider global account. The role operates in a highly matrixed environment, working closely with GFT Poland leadership and the Global Account Director. Success depends on the ability to lead through influence, earn trust and mobilise colleagues across sales, delivery, engineering, practices and leadership. **Your tasks** ***Client ownership and account growth*** * Own the day-to-day development of the global bank relationship in Poland, aligned to the global account strategy and GFT Poland priorities. * Build trusted relationships across the client organization, from engineering and delivery leaders through to senior technology and operations executives. * Develop and maintain a clear stakeholder, opportunity and engagement plan for Poland. * Identify client needs before they become formal procurements and convert them into qualified, winnable opportunities for GFT. * Joint leadership of the account with the Delivery Executive Manager * Act as the voice of the client inside GFT while representing GFT’s interests with confidence and integrity. ***Commercial leadership and deal shaping*** * Personally originate, shape and progress opportunities from initial client conversation through proposition, commercials, internal approval and closure. * Bring together the right GFT specialists to create differentiated propositions across AI-native engineering, AI-powered modernization, cloud and platform modernization, data, intelligent operations and managed services. * Develop commercially sound models spanning time and materials, managed capacity, managed services and outcome- or value-aligned constructs where appropriate. * Protect and grow the existing business in collaboration with the delivery team. * Own the Poland pipeline, forecast, revenue and margin outlook accountable to the Global Account Director, and CEO Poland. * Balance growth, competitiveness, delivery risk, client value and sustainable margin in every deal. ***Market presence*** * Bring GFT’s differentiated positioning into relevant senior client conversations, with a focus on measurable business value, engineering productivity and responsible adoption. * Identify where AI can change the economics and operating model of existing services, rather than simply add isolated point solutions. * Work with GFT experts to shape opportunities in software delivery, agentic engineering, modernization and intelligent operations. * Represent GFT credibly at client forums, roundtables, industry events, panels and selected media or thought-leadership activities in Poland. * Translate complex AI and technology topics into clear commercial and executive narratives without needing to be the technical architect. ***Account orchestration and client confidence*** * Create alignment across the Global Account Director, Poland leadership, delivery, engineering practices, legal, finance and commercial teams. * Partner with the Delivery Executive Manager to lead the account; collaborate on client satisfaction, risks, escalations and opportunities. * Maintain disciplined account governance, including actions, pipeline, commercial decisions, stakeholder coverage and strategic priorities. * Navigate the global-local matrix constructively, avoiding duplicated or conflicting engagement with the client. ***People and community leadership*** * Building and developing the account team. * Be a visible and trusted senior presence for GFT colleagues working with the global bank in Poland. * Build connection and belonging across teams, recognize successes, surface concerns early and help remove organisational barriers. * Act as a connector between local teams, global account leadership and the wider GFT organization, creating a strong sense of one team. * Listen to the people closest to the work and use their insight to improve the client relationship and identify opportunities. **What will make you successful** * Proven success growing a complex technology-services relationship in banking or financial services, preferably from inside the client environment rather than through remote or transactional selling. * Understanding of how banks buy services: procurement, regulation, supplier risk etc. * 10+ years' experience in technology services, engineering, managed capacity or staff augmentation, together with evidence of progressing relationships into larger, higher-value transformation engagements. * Strong commercial judgement and deal-shaping capability, including pricing, margin, risk, negotiation and contract or statement-of-work development. * Demonstrable ability to lead without authority and mobilize cross-functional, cross-border teams in a matrix organization. * Executive presence combined with a practical, sleeves-rolled-up approach. * Credibility in AI transformation, software engineering, modernisation, cloud and data. Deep technical specialism is not required, but curiosity and fluency are essential. * Comfort representing GFT externally through industry events, client forums, panels and thought leadership, with regular travel required. * A natural community builder who is accessible, dependable and invested in the success and wellbeing of the people around them. * Fluent English and Polish language capability and an established Kraków or Poland technology-services network are strongly advantageous. **What we offer** * A strategically important mandate within a major global banking relationship. * High autonomy and direct exposure to GFT Poland leadership, global account leadership and senior client stakeholders. * The opportunity to shape how GFT brings responsible AI-centric transformation and AI-native engineering to a global bank. * A collaborative international environment with access to GFT’s engineering, industry and partner ecosystem. * A competitive salary, variable pay linked to results, hybrid work and travel and flexible benefits package aligned to the local market. We are GFT Poland. **WE KNOW** how to tackle complex issues with innovative approach to deliver the highest value. Our reputation has been built around one simple rule: we do not overpromise, **WE DELIVER**. We deliver to our employees, clients and partners. WE GROW as you grow, so investing in you is our business strategy. Caring for each other is our priority. WE CARE who you are, what you need, how you feel. **WE CARE** to smile, have fun and develop as human beings. **Why Choose GFT?** ------------------- * A culture of top performance * Deep tech IT engineering & consulting * 1200 skilled & top-class experts * 77% of the team are regular/senior * Products that contribute to a sustainable world * Competitive salary and benefits * Ambitious projects, trainings and tools you need to flourish * Google Cloud Partner of the Year - for going above and beyond for customers

Wierzymy, że tworzenie oprogramowania umożliwiającego podejmowanie decyzji przez ludzi jest najlepszym sposobem na osiągnięcie tego celu. Współpracujemy z najważniejszymi instytucjami na świecie, aby przeobrazić sposób, w jaki wykorzystują dane i technologię. Na tym stanowisku potrzebne są umiejętności zarządzania projektami, optymalizacji procesów i skutecznej realizacji zadań. We have 118 years’ experience in bringing innovation to healthcare. And we are eager to do much more. Each year, close to 100 million people have a better day because of our medicines**.** At LEO Pharma, how we work matters. We build trusted relationships and deliver with impact. We focus on where we can make the greatest difference and have the courage to explore new possibilities. We collaborate across boundaries and take accountability for our part. Here, you can grow, contribute with confidence, and make a meaningful difference together with others. **Your role** You will lead HR Operations and Payroll services for designated geographies, ensuring employees receive accurate, timely and compliant support throughout their employment. * Deliver reliable HR Operations and Payroll services. Take accountability for consistent, high-quality service delivery and accurate, timely administration across the employee lifecycle. * Own end-to-end payroll delivery. Manage workloads, coach colleagues, oversee performance and build capabilities across HR Operations and Payroll. * Strengthen governance, quality and compliance. Monitor KPIs and SLAs, maintain effective controls and audit trails, and ensure compliance with payroll, tax, social security, labor law, data protection and company requirements. * Build effective partnerships and manage vendors. Collaborate with HR, Finance, IT, Legal and Operations Managers, ensuring external providers meet contractual obligations and service standards. * Drive smarter processes and systems. Advance standardization, automation and simplification, while supporting HR and payroll system implementations, upgrades, integrations and testing. * Guide change through clear communication. Lead or contribute to HR transformation and organizational change initiatives, keeping employees, managers and stakeholders informed about HR Operations and Payroll matters. **Your qualifications** To succeed in this role, we imagine that you have the following qualifications: * A bachelor’s or master’s degree in HR or a related field. * At least three years of leadership experience, preferably within HR Operations or Payroll, including managing teams across multiple locations. * Vendor management experience. * Proven knowledge of global HR policies, procedures and hire-to-retire administration. A good understanding of labor law; country-specific expertise is an advantage. * Strong experience with HR technology, preferably SuccessFactors and ServiceNow, proficiency in MS Office, * English at C1 level or above, an additional language is welcome. As a person you communicate clearly, build effective relationships and stay focused when priorities compete. Your network will include country HR Business Partners, Process Owners, HR Service Delivery, HRIS, and Rewards. Together with outsourcing partners, you will connect specialist expertise with everyday employee needs. **Your application** You do not need to upload a cover letter, but feel free to add a few sentences in your resume or CV on why this position has your interest. Please refrain from adding a photo to your CV. **Beyond the skin** Become part of LEO Pharma, a global leader in medical dermatology, as we go beyond the skin to make a lasting impact. We are the legacy-builders of the future – enabling people to have a better today and tomorrow. With the world as our lab, we are transforming innovative ideas into more effective and easier-to-use medicines. Through collaboration and partnerships, we can do much more. At LEO Pharma, we believe in the power of individuals to drive change. Our flat organizational structure empowers you to make a visible impact and offers versatile roles for professional growth. We value diversity and welcome applications from all qualified candidates, recognizing that our different perspectives, backgrounds, and attitudes enable us to make the best decisions. Join our passionate team at LEO Pharma and be yourself as we work together to make a fundamental difference. For certain positions, LEO Pharma might complete a background check conducted by a third party. Report a concern: **Whistleblower hotline | LEO Pharma** #LI-Onsite

The CRM team plays a critical role in enabling these activities by delivering technology solutions that support effective customer engagement and organisational performance. You will work closely with stakeholders across multiple functions, ensuring CRM solutions align with business needs and strategic priorities. The role requires the ability to balance operational delivery with long-term transformation objectives, helping to shape and enhance the British Council’s CRM landscape while supporting continuous improvement and innovation. The successful candidate will have significant project management experience, strong stakeholder management skills, and the ability to lead complex programmes of work in a fast-paced environment. You will be confident managing competing priorities, influencing senior stakeholders, and driving the successful delivery and adoption of CRM solutions that create lasting value for both customers and the organisation. You will oversee project scope, resources, risks, dependencies, budgets, timelines, and quality standards, ensuring that projects achieve agreed business outcomes while supporting improvements in customer experience and organisational performance. Working closely with a wide range of stakeholders, you will establish strong relationships with project sponsors, business leaders, end users, suppliers, and external partners to ensure successful project delivery and alignment with strategic priorities. This role focuses on real-time surveillance of all incoming and outgoing transactions to detect and investigate suspicious activities, ensuring compliance with AML/CTF regulations. **Key Responsibilities** * Monitor all transactions (incoming/outgoing monetary and non-monetary) against the transaction profile of client entities * Become familiar with the transactions and the counterparties of the client entities * Become familiar with the content of all client risk analysis within the team * Consult team members when detecting transactions which are not in line with the transaction profile * Create insight by building and submitting progress reports with regard to TPTM within the team * Report to the Transaction Monitoring Specialist on risks and possible improvements * Be the first point of contact within the team regarding Transaction Monitoring inquiries, escalation or advise can be obtained via Transaction Monitoring Specialist * Liaise with Other transaction monitoring related duties as assigned **Key Requirements** * Willing to become an expert and obtain knowledge with regard to AML * Ability to work under pressure with KPIs and deadlines * Critical, but practical (risk based) mindset * Skilled with IT, in particular well-developed skills in Excel * You are a pro-active team player, results-oriented and have problem-solving abilities * Knowledge or interest in AML, Financial Crime Frameworks/procedures/processes (AML, Sanctions, PEPs, etc.), Compliance, Regulatory matters **What’s in it for you?** * Convenient central location of the office * Stable employment * Flexi-time and remote working * An international and dynamic environment * Private medical care * Life insurance * Co-financing for the Multikafeteria program (e.g. Multisport card) * Access to a language platform with 12 different languages to learn * Access to a mental health and well-being platform offering a variety of functionalities that will support you in caring for your well-being * Exceptional people and atmosphere * Christmas and occasional gifts * Co-financing of holidays (social fund) * Opportunity to take part in charity projects **We’re looking forward to getting to know you!**
